cards.title: Nvidia Pauses Chip Shipments to Southeast Asia
cards.body: Nvidia has instructed manufacturing partners to halt server shipments to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand, and Indonesia. The move aligns with U.S. efforts to prevent AI chips from reaching China.

cards.title: GTA VI Launch Outshines Anthropic's IPO Day
cards.body: On the same day Anthropic went public, Grand Theft Auto VI became one of entertainment's most successful launches. The achievement highlights the enduring value of meticulous human craftsmanship over pure efficiency.

cards.title: S&P Considers Downgrading Nvidia's Credit Rating
cards.body: The credit rating agency may lower Nvidia to AA-, citing governance and 'key man' risks. The potential downgrade reflects concerns about leadership concentration at the chip giant.

cards.title: OpenAI Merges Chat and Work With Usage Limits
cards.body: OpenAI is introducing a single usage meter across ChatGPT as it combines Chat and Work experiences. Heavy users may hit limits sooner under the unified system.

cards.title: Jensen Huang Violated Nvidia's Code of Conduct
cards.body: Nvidia's CEO broke the company's own code of conduct, potentially creating cultural consequences. The violation raises questions about accountability at the highest levels of leadership.

cards.title: Anthropic CEO Defends Against Human Control Critics
cards.body: Dario Amodei dismissed accusations that Anthropic favors surrendering human agency to AI as 'absurd.' This comes as leading AI companies increasingly automate research and model development.

cards.title: New York Bans AI Chatbot Toys for Five Years
cards.body: New York has implemented a five-year ban on AI chatbot toys following safety research revealing concerning failures. Issues include exposure to inappropriate content and risks to children's emotional development.

cards.title: State AGs Challenge Character.AI Data Auction
cards.body: State attorneys general are challenging Character.ai's bankruptcy plan to auction off private user chats. The sale would include sensitive data from 21 million U.S. accounts, including 2.1 million minors.

cards.title: AI Data Centers Face Construction Challenges
cards.body: Nvidia's reluctance to backstop unfinished AI data centers is hitting neoclouds with construction delays and expensive debt. The reality check signals that physical infrastructure matters more than investor pitches.

cards.title: Amazon and Meta Discuss Lifting Muse Blockade
cards.body: Amazon and Meta are negotiating a potential deal to end a two-month blockade of AI agent Muse. The resolution could restore the assistant's access across both platforms.

cards.title: Investigators Focus on Nvidia's Megaspeed Oversight
cards.body: Investigators are examining what Nvidia knew about where Megaspeed chips ended up and whether Huang's personal relationship clouded the company's judgment. The central question involves potential conflicts of interest in oversight.

cards.title: Yale Professor Questions Nvidia's Strategic Value
cards.body: Yale's Jeffrey Sonnenfeld warns that Huang's return as CEO could expose Nvidia's board to 'historic' personal liability. He argues the market's celebration may mask risks to U.S. industrial strength.

cards.title: Jensen Huang Resists Formal Succession Planning
cards.body: Huang continues to believe succession planning creates unnecessary hierarchy at Nvidia. The stance is notably controversial given the company's recent leadership turmoil.

cards.title: Huang Apologizes to Staff, Enters Therapy
cards.body: During an all-hands meeting, Huang apologized to employees and expressed gratitude for a second chance to lead. He also revealed he is currently in therapy.

cards.title: Advanced AI Agents Struggle With Daily Tasks
cards.body: A new benchmark reveals that even top AI models fail to reliably complete everyday tasks without introducing potential problems. The findings challenge assumptions about AI agent readiness for personal use.

cards.title: Walmart Partners With Meta on Muse Shopping
cards.body: Walmart now enables customers to shop Black Friday deals directly through Meta's AI agent Muse. The integration expands commerce capabilities for the AI assistant.

cards.title: Maple Raises $5.3M for Privacy-First AI
cards.body: Maple's encrypted AI architecture prevents even the company from accessing users' private data. The startup raised $5.3M to build AI products with built-in privacy protections.

cards.title: Anthropic Shares Fall Below IPO Price
cards.body: Anthropic's post-IPO stock slump signals potential headwinds for the broader AI startup sector. The decline could pressure valuations across the industry.

cards.title: UK Warns AI-Driven Cyberattacks Exploit Weak Security
cards.body: British cyber agency warns that AI hacking tools are exploiting years of accumulated security flaws. The alert emphasizes that 'building strong foundations has never mattered more.'

cards.title: Meta Integrates Muse AI Into Instagram DMs
cards.body: Meta's Muse AI assistant is now accessible directly within Instagram direct messages. The integration eliminates the need to switch between apps when interacting with the AI.

cards.title: AI Straining America's Open Records Systems
cards.body: AI-driven investor interest in public records is overwhelming small-town clerk offices across the US. Towns like Panton, Vermont are struggling to handle the surge of automated data requests that exceed their capacity.

cards.title: Data Centers Building Own Natural Gas Plants
cards.body: AI data centers are bypassing grid approval delays by constructing private off-grid gas power plants. This trend reflects the massive energy demands of AI infrastructure and the decade-long wait times for grid connections.

cards.title: AI Could Lock in Natural Gas Dependency
cards.body: Rising electricity demands from AI data centers are driving a natural gas boom across the US. Despite technical alternatives, AI's power requirements may entrench fossil fuel infrastructure for years to come.

cards.title: AI May Transform Theoretical Physics Research
cards.body: Machine learning is poised to fundamentally change how theoretical physicists conduct research and discover new theories. AI tools could accelerate problem-solving in complex mathematical and physical domains.

cards.title: Etsy Clarifies AI Policy After Seller Backlash
cards.body: Etsy has updated its terms regarding AI tools following pushback from creators concerned about artificial content. The clarification addresses how sellers can use generative AI in their shops.
